objective: Verify realized trailing-30-day employment gross while minimizing user operations.

baseline.prior_user_step: Search for and open the latest payslip, then report gross pay.

result.reduced_step: Open the unread 2026-07-24 payroll-issuance notice in Gmail, tap the payroll link, and read only gross pay.
result.reason: The destination search was removed, but no amount or payment evidence is available without the user's existing authenticated payroll session.

success_condition: A non-sensitive gross-pay amount and, when available, payment date are read back and the trailing-30-day realized gross is recomputed.
withdrawal_condition: If the 2026-07-24 notice is no longer the latest, use the newest payroll-issuance notice; never request screenshots, credentials, codes, or personal identifiers.
effect_window: Next single weekly phone session or earlier if the user returns the completion signal.
privacy: No person, employer, email address, account identifier, notification identifier, portal URL, credential, code, or payslip content is stored.
